provenance: No8/Prius closed-loop simulation, not physical measurement
scope: All CSV rows and exported numeric columns, exact time and intended float32/uint8 conversion, finite values and full uniform grid. No product performance or physical-model qualification.
method: pandas round-trip decimal to float64 parsing, independent NumPy casting and bitwise comparison to PyArrow Parquet values; float64 statistics.

representative_interval.definition: Inclusive nearest samples; float64 reductions over exported values; slope uses cursor delta time.

gui_interval.definition: Inclusive nearest samples from displayed cursor times. Slope uses displayed cursor difference and may differ slightly from full internal cursor precision.
gui_interval.observations_source: Native viewer values transcribed by parent agent; only listed metrics were visually compared.
